current.kana: にくをはんきろください。

structure_explanation.en: A polite request with 〜をください ('give me ~, please'). 肉 (meat) is the object marked by を. 半㌔ ('half a kilo') is the quantity: 半 ('half') + ㌔ (an abbreviated form of キロ, 'kilo'), functioning as a quantity complement without needing a particle. ください ('please do the favor of giving') is the polite request form of くださる. N5 coverage: a request with 〜をください + a quantity expression.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: Pedido educado com 〜をください ('me dê ~, por favor'). 肉 ('carne') é o objeto marcado por を. 半㌔ ('meio quilo') é a quantidade: 半 ('meio/metade') + ㌔ (forma abreviada de キロ, 'quilo'), funcionando como complemento de quantidade sem precisar de partícula. ください ('faça o favor de dar') é a forma de pedido educado de くださる. Padrão: pedido com 〜をください + expressão de quantidade.

translation_literal.en: Meat, half a kilo, please give (me).
translation_literal.pt-BR: Carne, meio quilo, dê(-me) por favor.

translation.pt-BR: Meio quilo de carne, por favor.

note.en: polite imperative form (ください) of くださる; 〜をください = 'please give me ~'
note.pt-BR: forma imperativa educada (ください) de くださる; 〜をください = 'me dê ~, por favor'

objections.objection: The pt-BR leak was fixed ("Coverage de N5:" -> "Padrão:") but the parallel English sentence "N5 coverage: a request with 〜をください + a quantity expression." was left untouched, even though the op names it. The record's violations array still reports I5_METADATA_LEAK on structure_explanation.en, and en/pt-BR now diverge.
objections.auditor_hint: Replace "N5 coverage: a request with 〜をください + a quantity expression." with "Pattern: a request with 〜をください + a quantity expression."

current.jp: 私は六時に起きることにしている。
current.kana: わたしわろくじにおきることにしている。

structure_explanation.en: The N3 structure ～ことにしている: the verb 起きる (to wake up) is nominalized by こと and followed by にしている to express a self-imposed habit. 六時に (at six o'clock) is a time complement, with に marking the exact point on the clock. 私は establishes 'I' as the topic.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A estrutura N3 ～ことにしている: o verbo 起きる (acordar) é nominalizado por こと e seguido de にしている para expressar um hábito autoimposto. 六時に (às seis horas) é um complemento de tempo, com に marcando o ponto exato no relógio. 私は estabelece 'eu' como tópico.

translation_literal.en: As for me, I have the habit of waking up at six o'clock.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto a mim, tenho por hábito a coisa de acordar às seis horas.

translation.pt-BR: Faço questão de acordar às seis.

current.jp: 私はここで毎日泳いだものだ。
current.kana: わたしわここでまいにちおよいだものだ。

structure_explanation.en: 私 (I) is the topic marked by は. ここで (here) uses で to indicate the location of the action, and 毎日 (every day) is an adverb of frequency. The verb 泳いだ (swam, past of 泳ぐ) closes with ものだ, forming the ～ものだ pattern of recollection: 'I used to swim.' The final だ is the copula of the pattern.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: 私 (eu) é o tópico marcado por は. ここで (aqui) usa で para indicar o local da ação, e 毎日 (todo dia) é um advérbio de frequência. O verbo 泳いだ (nadei, passado de 泳ぐ) fecha com ものだ, formando o padrão ～ものだ de recordação: 'eu costumava nadar'. O だ final é a cópula do padrão.

translation_literal.en: As for me, here, every day, I used to swim (that's how it was).
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto a mim, aqui, todo dia, nadava (era assim).

translation.pt-BR: Eu costumava nadar aqui todos os dias.

note.pt-BR: forma passada de 泳ぐ (泳いだ)

role.en: past-tense auxiliary (た voiced to だ after 泳い)
role.pt-BR: auxiliar de tempo passado (た sonorizado em だ: 泳いだ)

role.en: formal noun (nominalizer) of the ～ものだ pattern (nostalgic recollection)

current.jp: 指を切るとすぐ血が出る。
current.kana: ゆびをきるとすぐちがでる。

structure_explanation.en: The sentence uses the conjunction と to express a natural/automatic consequence: "whenever A happens, B happens". The conditional clause is 指を切る ("to cut one's finger"), with を marking 指 as the direct object of 切る. After と comes the result: 血が出る ("blood comes out"), with が marking 血 as the subject of the intransitive verb 出る. The adverb すぐ ("right away, immediately") indicates that the result is immediate.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase usa a conjunção と para expressar uma consequência natural/automática: "sempre que A acontece, B acontece". A oração condicional é 指を切る ("cortar o dedo"), com を marcando 指 como objeto direto de 切る. Depois de と vem o resultado: 血が出る ("sai sangue"), com が marcando 血 como sujeito do verbo intransitivo 出る. O advérbio すぐ ("logo, na hora") indica que o resultado é imediato.

translation_literal.en: As for me, when I cut my finger, blood comes out right away.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto a [eu], ao cortar o dedo, logo o sangue sai.

translation.pt-BR: Quando corto o dedo, logo sai sangue.

note.en: dictionary form of 切る, followed by conditional と
note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário de 切る, seguida de と condicional

note.en: dictionary form of 出る (intransitive verb)
note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário de 出る (verbo intransitivo)

objections.objection: Topic-device rule broken in the shipping text (pre-existing, untouched by the ops, but it ships in "after"). jp is 指を切るとすぐ血が出る。 — there is no は anywhere in the sentence and no 私; the only particles are を, と, が. Yet lit_en opens "As for me," and lit_pt "Quanto a [eu],", inventing a topic phrase that mirrors nothing (and "Quanto a [eu]" is not even grammatical pt-BR — it would be "quanto a mim"). The record's own structure_explanation correctly lists only を/と/が.
objections.auditor_hint: lit_en: "When (I) cut a finger, blood comes out right away."  lit_pt: "Ao cortar o dedo, logo o sangue sai."

current.jp: 火事の時はベルを鳴らせよ。
current.kana: かじのときわべるをならせよ。

structure_explanation.en: 火事の時は ('at the time of a fire') is temporal/conditional, 火事 + の + 時, marked as topic by は. Core is 鳴らせ: 鳴らせ is the imperative form of the transitive verb 鳴らす ('to ring/sound'); final よ reinforces the command. Final よ reinforces the instruction. Note the parser treated 鳴ら as 鳴る + causative; in practice it equals the transitive 鳴らす ('to ring').
structure_explanation.pt-BR: 火事の時は ('na hora de um incêndio') é uma expressão temporal/condicional formada por 火事 ('incêndio') + の + 時 ('hora, momento'), marcada como tópico por は. O núcleo é o verbo 鳴らせ: 鳴らせ é a forma imperativa do verbo transitivo 鳴らす ('fazer soar'); a partícula final よ reforça a ordem. A frase termina com a partícula よ, que reforça a instrução. Observação: o analisador tratou 鳴ら como 鳴る + causativo; na prática equivale ao verbo transitivo 鳴らす ('fazer soar, tocar').

translation_literal.en: In case of fire, sound the bell.
translation_literal.pt-BR: De incêndio na hora, o sino faça-soar, viu.

translation.pt-BR: Em caso de incêndio, toque o sino.

note.en: verb base 鳴ら- that takes the causative suffix; equivalent to 'to make sound' (鳴らす)
note.pt-BR: base verbal 鳴ら- que recebe o sufixo causativo; equivale a 'fazer soar' (鳴らす)

objections.objection: The "after" value is not a gloss at all - it is the QA/editing INSTRUCTION that was supposed to produce the gloss, pasted verbatim into the learner-facing field: "Mirror 186677's せ token exactly: en \"(imperative ending, part of 鳴らせ)\", pt \"(terminação imperativa, parte de 鳴らせ)\", role \"auxiliar / terminação verbal\", notes stating it forms the imperative 鳴らせ with stem 鳴ら- and is NOT the standalone causative auxiliary せる." This is corpus-build metadata leaking into learner content, references another sentence by internal id, and mixes en+pt+role+note text into a single en gloss. Must not ship under any circumstance.

The confirmed op states the pt gloss carries the same false causative analysis, but "after" still reads "fazer com que (causativo)" - unchanged from "before". The defect is not fixed on the pt side, and it now contradicts the corrected structure_explanation (which says 鳴らせ is the imperative of 鳴らす) and whatever the en gloss was meant to become. Learners are still taught that せ here is the causative auxiliary.

The op explicitly named role "auxiliar causativo" and "both notes" as carrying the error, yet all four values are byte-identical between before and after: role.en "causative auxiliary", role.pt-BR "auxiliar causativo", note.en "causative suffix せ (from せる); here used as an imperative", note.pt-BR "sufixo causativo せ (de せる); aqui em uso imperativo". A bare causative stem cannot be an imperative, so the note is self-contradictory, and it now also contradicts the patched explanation in the same record.
